assumptions: Wind speed and direction are retained unchanged from MeteoSwiss hourly observations.
Cloud cover (oktas) is retained and interpolated; it serves as the Total Sky Cover basis in the EPW.
Opaque Sky Cover is treated as a proxy / fallback field when no independent source is available.
DHI and DNI are generated in the EPW completion layer via the Machard decomposition, not in the FRY selection layer.
